name: Baise Huiyi
source:
WhiTaers is a story about the protagonist looking for himself from being lost.
When did people start to lose themselves?
The new journey of confusion has begun.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/714130/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《WhTaers》是一个关于主角在迷失中寻找自我的故事。
人是从什么时候开始迷失自己的呢？
新的迷茫之旅已经开始。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/714130/]Steam[/url]]
